message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Deploy

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths-ignore:
      - 'web/**'
      - 'scripts/deploy-web.sh'
      - '.github/workflows/deploy-web.yml'
      - '**.md'
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      environment:
        description: 'Environment to deploy to'
        required: true
        default: 'default'
        type: choice
        options:
          - default

env:
  AWS_REGION: us-east-1

permissions:
  id-token: write
  contents: read

jobs:
  lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install uv
        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v4

      - name: Ruff check
        run: uvx ruff@0.17.3 check --output-format github

  deploy:
    needs: lint
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: ${{ inputs.environment || (github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && 'prod') || 'default' }}

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.13'

      - name: Install uv
        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v4

      - name: Cache uv dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cache/uv
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-uv-${{ hashFiles('uv.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-uv-

      - name: Install AWS SAM CLI
        uses: aws-actions/setup-sam@v2

      - name: Configure AWS credentials (OIDC)
        uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@v4
        with:
          role-to-assume: ${{ secrets.AWS_ROLE_ARN }}
          aws-region: ${{ env.AWS_REGION }}

      - name: Parse config
        id: config
        run: |
          CONFIG='${{ secrets.CONFIG }}'
          echo "$CONFIG" | jq -r 'to_entries | .[] | "\(.key)=\(.value)"' >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "$CONFIG" | jq -r '.[]' | while read -r value; do
            [ -n "$value" ] && echo "::add-mask::$value"
          done

      - name: Export dependencies
        run: |
          cd api && uv export --format=requirements-txt --no-hashes | grep -v "^-e \." > requirements.txt && cd ..
          cd admin && uv export --format=requirements-txt --no-hashes | grep -v "^-e \." > requirements.txt && cd ..
          cd worker && uv export --format=requirements-txt --no-hashes | grep -v "^-e \." > requirements.txt && cd ..

      - name: Build SAM application
        run: sam build

      - name: Deploy to AWS
        run: |
          PARAM_OVERRIDES=""
          [ -n "$DATABASE_URL" ] && PARAM_OVERRIDES="$PARAM_OVERRIDES DatabaseUrl=$DATABASE_URL"
          [ -n "$JWT_SECRET_KEY" ] && PARAM_OVERRIDES="$PARAM_OVERRIDES JwtSecretKey=$JWT_SECRET_KEY"
          [ -n "$DOMAIN_NAME" ] && PARAM_OVERRIDES="$PARAM_OVERRIDES DomainName=$DOMAIN_NAME"
          [ -n "$CERTIFICATE_ARN" ] && PARAM_OVERRIDES="$PARAM_OVERRIDES CertificateArn=$CERTIFICATE_ARN"
          [ -n "$GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID" ] && PARAM_OVERRIDES="$PARAM_OVERRIDES GoogleClientId=$GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID"
          [ -n "$SUBNET_IDS" ] && PARAM_OVERRIDES="$PARAM_OVERRIDES SubnetIds=$SUBNET_IDS"
          [ -n "$LAMBDA_SECURITY_GROUP_ID" ] && PARAM_OVERRIDES="$PARAM_OVERRIDES LambdaSecurityGroupId=$LAMBDA_SECURITY_GROUP_ID"
          [ -n "$TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN" ] && PARAM_OVERRIDES="$PARAM_OVERRIDES TelegramBotToken=$TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN"
          [ -n "$TELEGRAM_WEBHOOK_SECRET" ] && PARAM_OVERRIDES="$PARAM_OVERRIDES TelegramWebhookSecret=$TELEGRAM_WEBHOOK_SECRET"
          [ -n "$Y_AGENT_S3_BUCKET" ] && PARAM_OVERRIDES="$PARAM_OVERRIDES YAgentS3Bucket=$Y_AGENT_S3_BUCKET"
          [ -n "$OXYLABS_USERNAME" ] && PARAM_OVERRIDES="$PARAM_OVERRIDES OxylabsUsername=$OXYLABS_USERNAME"
          [ -n "$OXYLABS_PASSWORD" ] && PARAM_OVERRIDES="$PARAM_OVERRIDES OxylabsPassword=$OXYLABS_PASSWORD"
          [ -n "$ALPHAVANTAGE_API_KEY" ] && PARAM_OVERRIDES="$PARAM_OVERRIDES AlphaVantageApiKey=$ALPHAVANTAGE_API_KEY"
          [ -n "$OPENROUTER_API_KEY" ] && PARAM_OVERRIDES="$PARAM_OVERRIDES OpenRouterApiKey=$OPENROUTER_API_KEY"
          [ -n "$OPENROUTER_INFERENCE_API_KEY" ] && PARAM_OVERRIDES="$PARAM_OVERRIDES OpenRouterInferenceApiKey=$OPENROUTER_INFERENCE_API_KEY"
          [ -n "$DEEPSEEK_API_KEY" ] && PARAM_OVERRIDES="$PARAM_OVERRIDES DeepSeekApiKey=$DEEPSEEK_API_KEY"
          [ -n "$Y_AGENT_MCP_GATEWAY_URL" ] && PARAM_OVERRIDES="$PARAM_OVERRIDES McpGatewayUrl=$Y_AGENT_MCP_GATEWAY_URL"

          if [ -n "$PARAM_OVERRIDES" ]; then
            sam deploy --no-confirm-changeset --no-fail-on-empty-changeset --parameter-overrides $PARAM_OVERRIDES
          else
            sam deploy --no-confirm-changeset --no-fail-on-empty-changeset
          fi",
  "rationale": "The deploy job repeatedly resolves/downloads Python dependencies (uv export for api, admin, worker) with no dependency cache, while uv.lock exists and Python 3.13 is pinned. Pattern P-LIT-GHA-CACHE (Cache dependency downloads) supports lockfile-keyed dependency caching with reported modest benefit, and the measured experiment (batch-hiruni-pattern-bat-ae496965ffa682a2-r2) showed adding actions/cache for pip/~/.cache dependencies saved about 9.2% elapsed time. Adding a single actions/cache step for ~/.cache/uv keyed on hashFiles('uv.lock') is minimal, preserves all build/deploy coverage and required checks, adds no new secrets, privileged actions, publishing/deployment, or network targets, and needs no permission change (contents: read is already present).",
  "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE", "experiment:batch-hiruni-pattern-bat-ae496965ffa682a2-r2"]
}

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: ${{ inputs.environment || (github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && 'prod') || 'default' }}

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.13'

      - name: Install uv
        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v4

      - name: Cache uv dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cache/uv
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-uv-${{ hashFiles('uv.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-uv-

      - name: Install AWS SAM CLI
        uses: aws-actions/setup-sam@v2

      - name: Configure AWS credentials (OIDC)
        uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@v4
        with:
          role-to-assume: ${{ secrets.AWS_ROLE_ARN }}
          aws-region: ${{ env.AWS_REGION }}

      - name: Parse config
        id: config
        run: |
          CONFIG='${{ secrets.CONFIG }}'
          echo "$CONFIG" | jq -r 'to_entries | .[] | "\(.key)=\(.value)"' >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "$CONFIG" | jq -r '.[]' | while read -r value; do
            [ -n "$value" ] && echo "::add-mask::$value"
          done

      - name: Export dependencies
        run: |
          cd api && uv export --format=requirements-txt --no-hashes | grep -v "^-e \\." > requirements.txt && cd ..
          cd admin && uv export --format=requirements-txt --no-hashes | grep -v "^-e \\." > requirements.txt && cd ..
          cd worker && uv export --format=requirements-txt --no-hashes | grep -v "^-e \\." > requirements.txt && cd ..

      - name: Build SAM application
        run: sam build

      - name: Deploy to AWS
        run: |
          PARAM_OVERRIDES=""
          [ -n "$DATABASE_URL" ] && PARAM_OVERRIDES="$PARAM_OVERRIDES DatabaseUrl=$DATABASE_URL"
          [ -n "$JWT_SECRET_KEY" ] && PARAM_OVERRIDES="$PARAM_OVERRIDES JwtSecretKey=$JWT_SECRET_KEY"
          [ -n "$DOMAIN_NAME" ] && PARAM_OVERRIDES="$PARAM_OVERRIDES DomainName=$DOMAIN_NAME"
          [ -n "$CERTIFICATE_ARN" ] && PARAM_OVERRIDES="$PARAM_OVERRIDES CertificateArn=$CERTIFICATE_ARN"
          [ -n "$GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID" ] && PARAM_OVERRIDES="$PARAM_OVERRIDES GoogleClientId=$GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID"
          [ -n "$SUBNET_IDS" ] && PARAM_OVERRIDES="$PARAM_OVERRIDES SubnetIds=$SUBNET_IDS"
          [ -n "$LAMBDA_SECURITY_GROUP_ID" ] && PARAM_OVERRIDES="$PARAM_OVERRIDES LambdaSecurityGroupId=$LAMBDA_SECURITY_GROUP_ID"
          [ -n "$TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN" ] && PARAM_OVERRIDES="$PARAM_OVERRIDES TelegramBotToken=$TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN"
          [ -n "$TELEGRAM_WEBHOOK_SECRET" ] && PARAM_OVERRIDES="$PARAM_OVERRIDES TelegramWebhookSecret=$TELEGRAM_WEBHOOK_SECRET"
          [ -n "$Y_AGENT_S3_BUCKET" ] && PARAM_OVERRIDES="$PARAM_OVERRIDES YAgentS3Bucket=$Y_AGENT_S3_BUCKET"
          [ -n "$OXYLABS_USERNAME" ] && PARAM_OVERRIDES="$PARAM_OVERRIDES OxylabsUsername=$OXYLABS_USERNAME"
          [ -n "$OXYLABS_PASSWORD" ] && PARAM_OVERRIDES="$PARAM_OVERRIDES OxylabsPassword=$OXYLABS_PASSWORD"
          [ -n "$ALPHAVANTAGE_API_KEY" ] && PARAM_OVERRIDES="$PARAM_OVERRIDES AlphaVantageApiKey=$ALPHAVANTAGE_API_KEY"
          [ -n "$OPENROUTER_API_KEY" ] && PARAM_OVERRIDES="$PARAM_OVERRIDES OpenRouterApiKey=$OPENROUTER_API_KEY"
          [ -n "$OPENROUTER_INFERENCE_API_KEY" ] && PARAM_OVERRIDES="$PARAM_OVERRIDES OpenRouterInferenceApiKey=$OPENROUTER_INFERENCE_API_KEY"
          [ -n "$DEEPSEEK_API_KEY" ] && PARAM_OVERRIDES="$PARAM_OVERRIDES DeepSeekApiKey=$DEEPSEEK_API_KEY"
          [ -n "$Y_AGENT_MCP_GATEWAY_URL" ] && PARAM_OVERRIDES="$PARAM_OVERRIDES McpGatewayUrl=$Y_AGENT_MCP_GATEWAY_URL"

          if [ -n "$PARAM_OVERRIDES" ]; then
            sam deploy --no-confirm-changeset --no-fail-on-empty-changeset --parameter-overrides $PARAM_OVERRIDES
          else
            sam deploy --no-confirm-changeset --no-fail-on-empty-changeset
          fi
